quests.instruction: Which flat, paved path do cars and trucks drive along?
quests.hint: Think about the paved path right outside your house that cars drive on.
quests.explanation: A road is a flat, paved path for vehicles to drive on. Roads connect towns, cities, and homes together!
quests.funFact: The very first paved roads were built thousands of years ago to help people travel more easily!

quests.instruction: Which wide road connects faraway cities and lets cars drive very fast?
quests.hint: Think about a big, wide road with several lanes where cars zoom along quickly between cities.
quests.explanation: A highway is a wide road that connects cities. Cars can drive fast on a highway with several lanes!
quests.funFact: Some highways stretch for thousands of miles, connecting cities all the way across a country!

quests.instruction: Which road runs through a neighborhood, lined with houses on both sides?
quests.hint: Think about the road right in front of your own home, lined with neighbors' houses.
quests.explanation: A street is a road that runs through a neighborhood. Streets are usually lined with houses and shops!
quests.funFact: Many streets are named after trees, people, or special local landmarks!

quests.instruction: Which structure lets cars and people cross safely over a river or valley?
quests.hint: Think about the long structure that lets you drive right over a wide river instead of around it.
quests.explanation: A bridge is a structure that lets vehicles cross over water or a valley. Bridges connect two sides safely!
quests.funFact: Some bridges are so long that it can take several minutes to drive all the way across!

quests.instruction: Which underground passage lets cars or trains travel straight through a mountain?
quests.hint: Think about a dark passage carved through a mountain, letting a road or train tracks pass right through it.
quests.explanation: A tunnel is an underground passage through a mountain or under water. Tunnels let vehicles travel straight through!
quests.funFact: Digging a very long tunnel can take construction crews many years to finish!

quests.instruction: Which busy place has runways where airplanes take off and land?
quests.hint: Think about the busy building where you check in your bags before flying somewhere far away.
quests.explanation: An airport is a place with runways for airplanes. Airports have gates, luggage areas, and busy runways!
quests.funFact: The world's busiest airports handle thousands of takeoffs and landings every single day!

quests.instruction: Which building has platforms where passengers wait to board a train?
quests.hint: Think about the building with platforms where you stand waiting for your train to arrive.
quests.explanation: A train station is a building with platforms for boarding trains. Passengers wait here for their train to arrive!
quests.funFact: Some train stations are so grand and beautiful that people visit just to admire the building!

quests.instruction: Which small marked spot on the sidewalk is where a bus picks up waiting passengers?
quests.hint: Think about the little sign or bench on the sidewalk where you wait for your bus to arrive.
quests.explanation: A bus stop is a marked spot where a bus picks up passengers. Bus stops often have a bench or a sign!
quests.funFact: A bus follows the very same route, stopping at the same bus stops, all day long!

quests.instruction: Which sheltered area of water keeps boats and ships safe from big waves?
quests.hint: Think about a calm, protected area of water where boats can rest safely away from rough waves.
quests.explanation: A harbor is a sheltered area of water for boats. Harbors protect ships from big waves and storms!
quests.funFact: A harbor's calm, protected waters make it a safe place for ships to load and unload cargo!

quests.instruction: Which busy place along the coast is where ships load and unload their cargo?
quests.hint: Think about the busy place by the sea where huge ships stop to load and unload their cargo.
quests.explanation: A port is a busy coastal place where ships load and unload cargo. Ports connect ships to trucks and trains!
quests.funFact: Some of the busiest ports in the world handle millions of shipping containers every year!

quests.instruction: Which wooden platform lets you step safely from land onto a boat?
quests.hint: Think about a wooden platform stretching out over the water, where a boat ties up right beside it.
quests.explanation: A dock is a platform where a boat can be tied up. Docks let people step safely onto or off a boat!
quests.funFact: Boats are tied to a dock using strong ropes so they do not drift away!

quests.instruction: Which long structure stretches out over the water, often with shops or rides on it?
quests.hint: Think about a long wooden walkway stretching far out over the ocean, sometimes with fun rides at the end.
quests.explanation: A pier is a long structure that stretches out over water. Some piers have shops, rides, or fishing spots!
quests.funFact: Walking to the end of a long pier lets you feel like you are standing right in the middle of the ocean!

quests.instruction: Which long, flat strip does an airplane use to take off and land?
quests.hint: Think about the very long, flat strip of pavement an airplane races down before lifting into the sky.
quests.explanation: A runway is a long, flat strip for airplanes. Airplanes speed down a runway to take off or land!
quests.funFact: A runway must be very long so a heavy airplane has enough space to speed up before takeoff!

quests.instruction: Which colorful signal tells drivers exactly when to stop, wait, or go?
quests.hint: Think about the signal with red, yellow, and green lights hanging above a busy street corner.
quests.explanation: A traffic light is a signal that tells drivers when to stop or go. Red means stop, and green means go!
quests.funFact: The very first traffic light was used over a hundred years ago to help control busy streets!

quests.instruction: Which posted sign gives drivers important information or rules about the road ahead?
quests.hint: Think about a sign along the road that tells drivers to slow down, turn, or watch for something ahead.
quests.explanation: A traffic sign is a posted sign with road information. Traffic signs help drivers know the rules ahead!
quests.funFact: Traffic signs use bright colors and simple shapes so drivers can understand them at a quick glance!

quests.instruction: Which painted stripes on the road show people exactly where it is safe to walk across?
quests.hint: Think about the painted white stripes on the road that show you exactly where to walk across safely.
quests.explanation: A crosswalk is painted stripes showing a safe place to walk. People cross the street inside a crosswalk!
quests.funFact: Looking both ways before stepping into a crosswalk always helps keep pedestrians extra safe!

quests.instruction: Which paved path beside the road is just for people walking, not for cars?
quests.hint: Think about the paved path right beside the road where people walk instead of on the street.
quests.explanation: A sidewalk is a paved path for walking beside a road. Sidewalks keep walkers safely away from traffic!
quests.funFact: Sidewalks help keep people who are walking safely separated from cars and trucks on the road!

quests.instruction: Which large paved area has painted lines where drivers leave their cars?
quests.hint: Think about the big paved area outside a store with painted lines showing where to park your car.
quests.explanation: A parking lot is a paved area for parking cars. Parking lots have painted lines showing each parking space!
quests.funFact: A large parking lot can hold hundreds of cars at the very same time!

quests.instruction: Which covered space, often attached to a house, keeps a car safe and dry?
quests.hint: Think about the covered space next to your home where the family car is parked overnight.
quests.explanation: A garage is a covered space that keeps a car safe. Many homes have a garage attached right next to them!
quests.funFact: A garage keeps a car dry and protected from rain, snow, and hot sunshine!

quests.instruction: Which place has pumps where drivers stop to fill their car's fuel tank?
quests.hint: Think about the place with tall pumps where a car stops so it can fill up before a long trip.
quests.explanation: A gas station is a place with pumps for filling a car's tank. Drivers stop here to fuel up before a trip!
quests.funFact: A gas station pump can fill an entire car's tank in just a few short minutes!

quests.instruction: Which small building on a highway collects a small fee before drivers continue on their way?
quests.hint: Think about the small booth on certain highways where a driver pays a little money before driving through.
quests.explanation: A toll booth is a small building that collects a fee from drivers. Drivers pay a small amount before continuing!
quests.funFact: Money collected at toll booths often helps pay to keep roads and bridges in good repair!

quests.instruction: Which pair of metal tracks guides a train exactly where it needs to go?
quests.hint: Think about the two long metal rails laid side by side that a train's wheels roll along.
quests.explanation: A railway is a pair of metal tracks for trains. Railways guide a train's wheels exactly where it needs to go!
quests.funFact: Railways stretch for many thousands of miles, connecting cities and towns all across the world!

quests.instruction: Which raised walkway at a station is where passengers stand to board a train?
quests.hint: Think about the raised walkway right beside the tracks where you stand waiting to step onto a train.
quests.explanation: A platform is a raised walkway at a station. Passengers stand on a platform before boarding a train!
quests.funFact: A bright yellow line is often painted along a platform to remind passengers to stand a safe distance back!

quests.instruction: Which large building at an airport or station connects passengers to their gates?
quests.hint: Think about the big building where you check in your bags before walking to your airplane's gate.
quests.explanation: A terminal is a large building that connects passengers to their gates. Airports and stations both have terminals!
quests.funFact: Some airports are so busy they need several huge terminals just to handle all their passengers!

quests.instruction: Which huge building keeps airplanes safely stored and repaired out of the weather?
quests.hint: Think about the giant building at an airport big enough to fit a whole airplane inside for repairs.
quests.explanation: A hangar is a huge building for storing airplanes. Hangars protect airplanes from wind, rain, and sun!
quests.funFact: A hangar must be built extremely tall and wide just to fit one airplane's wings safely inside!

quests.instruction: Which tall tower flashes a bright light to guide ships safely away from rocky shores at night?
quests.hint: Think about a tall tower by the sea with a bright, spinning light that warns ships at night.
quests.explanation: A lighthouse is a tall tower with a flashing light. Lighthouses guide ships safely away from rocky shores!
quests.funFact: Old lighthouses once burned real flames, but today most use bright, modern electric lights!

quests.instruction: Which circular road lets cars flow smoothly around a center island instead of stopping at a light?
quests.hint: Think about a circular road where cars drive around and around a center island to choose their turn.
quests.explanation: A roundabout is a circular road around a center island. Cars flow smoothly around it instead of stopping!
quests.funFact: A well-designed roundabout can actually keep traffic moving faster than a regular traffic light!

quests.instruction: Which raised road lets cars drive safely above another busy road below?
quests.hint: Think about a road built up high, letting cars pass safely right above another busy road underneath.
quests.explanation: An overpass is a raised road above another road. Overpasses let two busy roads cross without meeting!
quests.funFact: Driving on an overpass gives you a great bird's-eye view of the road below!

quests.instruction: Which road dips down and passes safely beneath another busy road above it?
quests.hint: Think about a road that dips down low, letting cars drive safely under another road passing overhead.
quests.explanation: An underpass is a road that passes beneath another road. Underpasses let two busy roads cross safely!
quests.funFact: An underpass helps traffic keep flowing smoothly without ever needing to stop at a crossing!

quests.instruction: Which spot along a highway lets tired drivers safely stop to rest and stretch their legs?
quests.hint: Think about the spot along a long highway with restrooms and picnic tables, perfect for a short break.
quests.explanation: A rest stop is a spot along a highway for resting. Tired drivers stop here to stretch and take a short break!
quests.funFact: Taking a short break at a rest stop helps drivers stay alert and safe on a long trip!
